readmeMarkdown:
English | Simplified Chinese



**Unified orchestration across coding agents.** Connect **Antigravity**, **Codex**, **Claude Code**, **DeepSeek Harness**, and more through one async delegation protocol. [![Cospan orchestration adapter connecting Antigravity, Codex, Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness](assets/design.png)](assets/design.svg) **[40s Demo](#40s-demo) · [Why Cospan](#why-cospan) · [Core CUJs](#core-cujs) · [Install](#install) · [Harnesses](#harnesses) · [Roadmap](#roadmap) · [References](#references-and-license)** ## 40s Demo https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f51a33fc-486c-479c-95d5-3cf35a1aeab1 ## Why Cospan Frontier coding models perform best inside the native harnesses they were co-trained with—so the real unit of orchestration is **`Model × Harness`**, and different ecosystems bring distinct strengths: **Gemini 4 Carbon** (`agy`) for architecture and planning, **GPT-6.2-Sol** (`codex`) for deep bug-hunting review, **GPT-6.1-Terra** (`codex`) for live GUI and browser computer use, and **Claude** (`claude`) for frontend craft. Combining them unlocks massive leverage; humans can bridge harnesses manually with handoff prompts today, but orchestration belongs to the agents themselves. Inspired and battle-tested by [`agy-staff`](https://github.com/keli-wen/agy-staff), Cospan turns cross-harness delegation into an **async, progressively disclosed protocol** behind one unified adapter: your host dispatches peer `Model × Harness` units in the background, stays unblocked with a clean context window, and pulls live status or full execution traces only when needed—forming a clean foundation for next-generation multi-agent collaboration. ![Why Cospan minimalist line-art diagram: moving from manual handoff ("You are the router") to Cospan ("Agents orchestrate peers") across Model × Harness units with async progressive disclosure](assets/why.png) ## Core CUJs ### Basic dispatch: one command, zero plumbing Invoke `/cospan-` (or `/cospan:` in Claude Code, `$cospan:` in Codex) and specify any target **model**, **reasoning effort**, or **timeout** right in your prompt: ```text /cospan-codex Use sol (high effort, 20m timeout) to review src/webhook/ and flag real edge cases. ``` > [!TIP] > **Handled automatically under the hood (no need to manage this yourself):** Your host agent autonomously frames context (inline text or `--prompt-file`), launches a detached background session (`send`), monitors progress non-blockingly (`wait` / bounded `observe`, inspecting full trajectory logs only if needed), and collects the result—or resumes the same session (`continue`) for follow-up turns. ### Unified live sidebar (`agy` & `dsh`) Installing on **Antigravity (`agy`)** or **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)** adds the unified Cospan sidebar panel—tracking live background runs across all four harnesses, inspecting Q&A outputs, and aggregating sibling Git worktrees (`wt:*`) in one view ([Install ↓](#install)):

### Cross-ecosystem workflows - **Fan out 2× Sol slice reviews from Carbon** _(Antigravity → 2× Codex)_ — Split deep code reviews across modules without blocking local tests; staggered async results merge cleanly on wakeup: > `/cospan-codex` _"Fan out 2 `sol` reviews across `webhook/` and `retry/` for real bugs."_ ![Gemini 4 Carbon uses 2 GPT-6.2-Sol reviewers to audit webhook/ & retry/ in parallel without blocking](assets/cuj-carbon-sol.svg) - **Multi-turn Carbon second brain for Astra** _(Codex ⇄ Antigravity)_ — Stress-test migration plans against a second model family and follow up in the same session while staying unblocked locally: > `$cospan:agy` _"Ask `carbon` to stress-test `docs/plan.md`, propose a cleaner route, and verify crash recovery."_ ![GPT-6.2-Astra consults Gemini 4 Carbon across 2 turns to stress-test docs/plan.md & verify crash safety](assets/cuj-astra-carbon.svg) - **Live browser & GUI testing via Terra** _(Claude Code → Codex)_ — Keep code and unit-test orchestration in **Claude Sonnet**, while **GPT-6.1-Terra** drives the live browser to catch layout bugs: > `/cospan:codex` _"Have `terra` open the local app and walk through the checkout coupon flow."_ ![Claude Sonnet uses GPT-6.1-Terra to drive the browser GUI, test SAVE20 at 375px, and catch a mobile CTA bug](assets/cuj-claude-terra.svg) - **Offload repo scans & race checks to protect Fable quota** _(Claude Code → Antigravity + DeepSeek Harness)_ — Save scarce flagship context and quota by delegating repo surveys and concurrency checks simultaneously: > _"Map auth token refresh with `hydrogen` and verify 401 race conditions with `v4.1-flash`."_ ![Claude Fable offloads auth mapping to Gemini 4 Hydrogen & race checks to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in parallel](assets/cuj-fanout-sidecars.svg) - **End-to-end research & review pipeline from Carbon** _(Antigravity ⇄ Codex + ×N Antigravity)_ — Drive a full plan → gate → bulk experiment → final audit → fix pass loop across **Astra**, **Hydrogen ×N**, and **Sol**: > _"Have `astra` review my spec, fan out `hydrogen` across all experiment configs, audit with `sol`, and send `sol`'s fixes back to `hydrogen` for one final pass."_ ![Carbon (host) plans with Astra, fans out Hydrogen ×N, audits via Sol, and passes fixes to Hydrogen](assets/cuj-research-pipeline.svg) ## Install Requires **Node.js `>= 20`** plus whichever coding agent CLIs you want to connect (`agy`, `claude`, `codex`, `dsh`). > [!TIP] > **Recommended — For agents:** Paste this into any coding agent to let it detect your environment, install Cospan, and verify CLI contracts automatically: > > ```text > Read the raw text of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keli-wen/cospan/master/docs/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md > (curl it — do not work from a summary) and follow it to install and verify Cospan for the harness you are running in. > Respond in the user's language. > ``` ### Manual install **Antigravity (`agy`)** ```bash git clone https://github.com/keli-wen/cospan.git ~/.cospan/repo node ~/.cospan/repo/bin/cospan.mjs install --host agy ``` **Claude Code (`claude`)** ```bash claude plugin marketplace add keli-wen/cospan claude plugin install cospan@cospan ``` **OpenAI Codex (`codex`)** ```bash codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/keli-wen/cospan codex plugin add cospan@cospan ``` **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)** ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:keli-wen/cospan ``` _(Or in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: **Plugins** → install from `github:keli-wen/cospan`.)_ Restart Claude Code or Codex afterwards so the plugin loads (`/cospan-…` in Antigravity and DeepSeek Harness, `/cospan:…` in Claude Code, `$cospan:…` in Codex—or describe what you want in plain language).
Upgrading & diagnostics - **Antigravity (`agy`)**: `git -C ~/.cospan/repo pull --ff-only && node ~/.cospan/repo/bin/cospan.mjs install --host agy` - **Claude Code (`claude`)**: `claude plugin marketplace update cospan && claude plugin update cospan@cospan` - **OpenAI Codex (`codex`)**: `codex plugin marketplace upgrade && codex plugin add cospan@cospan` - **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)**: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'github:keli-wen/cospan#'` Claude Code and Codex cache plugins by version and require a restart after upgrading. Run `node /bin/cospan.mjs doctor --check` (zero tokens) at any time to verify installed CLI binaries and flag contracts; see [docs/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md](docs/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md) for cache-refresh and Windows notes.
## Harnesses | Harness | Ecosystem | Built-in model shortcuts | | ---------------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | | **Antigravity** (`agy`) | Google · Gemini & Claude | `flash`, `neon`, `carbon`, `argon`, `hydrogen`, `opus`, `sonnet` | | **Codex** (`codex`) | OpenAI · GPT | `sol`, `terra`, `astra`, `luna` | | **Claude Code** (`claude`) | Anthropic · Claude | `sonnet`, `opus`, `haiku`, `fable` | | **DeepSeek Harness** (`dsh`) | DeepSeek & custom providers | `v4.1-flash` / `flash`, `v4-pro` / `pro`, `/` | _More harnesses are on the way—Cospan's driver layer is designed to plug in additional coding agent CLIs cleanly._ ## Roadmap - [ ] **Cross-machine peer delegation over SSH** — Fire-and-collect async task handoff across machines (LAN / Tailscale) via short-lived SSH, keeping remote credentials and execution isolated without long-lived connections. ## References and License - **[`agy-staff`](https://github.com/keli-wen/agy-staff)** — Hire Google's Antigravity CLI (`agy`) as a fast worker and second brain across Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, Pi, and OpenCode. Cospan generalizes the async `jobs` protocol and progressive disclosure architecture first pioneered and benchmarked in `agy-staff` ([Bench v1 Tech Report](https://lastwhisper.dev/en/zen-of-harness-engineering/agy-staff-bench-v1/)). - **Community** — [LINUX DO](https://linux.do/) (_Where possible begins_, a developer & AI community). - **License** — [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Keli Wen · Release notes in [`docs/releases/`](docs/releases/) · Architecture & contributor guide in [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md).

# cospan 0.1.3 — Batch WaitAll, Cross-Worktree Lookup & Future `agy` Model Families

![cospan 0.1.3 overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keli-wen/cospan/v0.1.3/releases/assets/cospan-0.1.3-overview.png)

_Header illustration generated via [`cospan-codex`](https://github.com/keli-wen/cospan/blob/v0.1.3/skills/codex/SKILL.md)._

## Highlights

`cospan` **0.1.3** makes parallel multi-agent workflows and linked Git worktrees work seamlessly end-to-end: collect multiple concurrent jobs in a single **WaitAll** barrier across CLI and MCP, address sibling worktree jobs directly by `<job-id>` from the main repository, use future versioned Gemini and Claude models on `agy` with `--effort` immediately, and contribute via new agent-first issue/PR templates.

### What's New

- **Batch `WaitAll` across CLI, MCP, and host skills (#10, #13)**:
  - `cospan wait <id1> <id2> ... [--timeout <dur>]` and MCP `cospan_wait({ cwd, ids: [...] })` now support pure `allSettled` batch waiting: all listed jobs run to completion without canceling siblings on early failure, deliverables render in caller-specified order separated by `\n---\n\n`, and exit codes follow highest-severity precedence (`3` error/crashed > `4` canceled > `5` attention > `0` all done).
  - Deduplicates repeated IDs, fails fast on unknown IDs, and keeps 0-arg / 1-arg `cospan wait` 100% backwards-compatible.
  - On `--timeout` while any job is still running, prints a bounded (`<= 8 KiB`) JSON summary (`status: "running"`, `completed_ids`, `pending_ids`, per-job `status`) with exit code `2` without dumping completed bodies yet—preventing duplicate context on subsequent `wait` calls.
  - Updated all generated host skill templates (`agy`, `codex`, `claude`, `dsh`, `jobs`) to spell out when to batch `wait` (next step needs all parallel outputs together) vs. issue separate `wait` calls (uneven runtimes where acting on the first completion matters).
- **Cross-worktree explicit `<job-id>` CLI resolution (#9, #12)**:
  - CLI and MCP commands passed an explicit `<job-id>` (`observe`, `status <id>`, `result`, `wait`, `cancel`, `continue --id`, `restart`, and batch `wait`) now fall back across sibling Git worktrees in the same repository family—matching the jobs surfaced in the unified sidebar (`wt:*`).
  - `continue --id` and `restart` preserve the original worktree working directory (`cwd`) and fail cleanly if a removed worktree directory no longer exists, while read-only lookups (`observe`, `result`, `status <id>`) continue working after worktree removal via the repo index.
  - All no-ID commands (`status`, `wait`, `result`, `observe`, `continue --last`) remain strictly isolated to the current worktree so `--last` never crosses branches.
- **Generalized Gemini & Claude effort resolution for `agy` (#11, #14)**:
  - Extended `agy` model-family detection beyond its hardcoded 10-entry allowlist to recognize future versioned `gemini-<digit>*` and `claude-(opus|sonnet|haiku)-*` model IDs automatically.
  - Checks existing `-(low|medium|high|xhigh)` suffixes before family matching so already-suffixed models never get double-suffixed, while explicit `--effort` cleanly overrides the suffix.
  - Preserves known-family clamping (`gemini-4-carbon`, `claude-opus-5-5`, etc. clamp `xhigh -> high`; `gemini-4-neon`, `gemini-4-hydrogen`, and unknown future `gemini-\d*` families allow `xhigh`) and verbatim passthrough for custom/enterprise non-family models.
- **Agent-first contributor docs, human-first PR template & Release Checklist (#8, #15, #17)**:
  - Added `CONTRIBUTING.md` with the change-surface verification matrix, offline `tests/fakes/*` policy, `Type + Area` labeling rules, and deterministic 5-step `Release Checklist`, plus structured GitHub Issue Forms and a human-first PR template emphasizing plain-language `TL;DR` + `Before → After` examples instead of diff narration.

## Validation

- `npm run lint`
- `npm run format:check`
- `npm test` (63 offline tests: 57 passing on macOS/Linux with 6 `win32`-only skipped)
- `node bin/cospan.mjs install`
- `node bin/cospan.mjs doctor --check`

## Upgrade

> [!TIP]
> **Recommended — For coding agents:** Paste this into any coding agent to upgrade Cospan to `v0.1.3` and verify CLI contracts for your current harness automatically:
>
> ```text
> Read the raw text of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keli-wen/cospan/master/docs/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md
> (curl it — do not work from a summary) and follow it to upgrade Cospan to v0.1.3 and verify it for the harness you are running in.
> Respond in the user's language.
> ```

<details>
<summary>Manual upgrade commands (agy / claude / codex / dsh)</summary>

- **Antigravity (`agy`)**: `git -C ~/.cospan/repo pull --ff-only && node ~/.cospan/repo/bin/cospan.mjs install --host agy`
- **Claude Code (`claude`)**: `claude plugin marketplace update cospan && claude plugin update cospan@cospan`
- **OpenAI Codex (`codex`)**: `codex plugin marketplace upgrade && codex plugin add cospan@cospan`
- **DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)**: `dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'github:keli-wen/cospan#v0.1.3'`

Restart Claude Code or Codex after upgrading, then run `node <cospan-root>/bin/cospan.mjs doctor --check` (zero tokens). For first-time setup, Windows notes, or cache refreshes, see [README.md](https://github.com/keli-wen/cospan/blob/v0.1.3/README.md#install) and [docs/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md](https://github.com/keli-wen/cospan/blob/v0.1.3/docs/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md).

</details>

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/keli-wen/cospan/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
